env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

env CC=

env CGO_ENABLED=

[cgo] go build -o g-go.bin .
[cgo] logos build -o g-logos.bin .
[cgo] logos env CGO_ENABLED
[cgo] stdout '^1$'

cd plain
[cgo] go build -o $WORK/plain-go.bin .
[cgo] ! logos build -o $WORK/plain-logos.bin .
[cgo] stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\]'
[cgo] logos env CGO_ENABLED
[cgo] stdout '^0$'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/g

go 1.27

-- main.go --
package main

/*
int answer() { return 42; }
*/
import "C"

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("g:", C.answer()) }

-- sub/go.mod --
module example.com/g/sub

go 1.27

-- sub/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("sub") }

-- plain/go.mod --
module example.com/g/plain

go 1.27

-- plain/main.go --
package main

/*
int answer() { return 42; }
*/
import "C"

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("plain:", C.answer()) }

-- plain/lgo/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("lgo") }
